_doc: Reed CAPTURE-WISHLIST — what Paul should shoot. Front of the Reed->Maya pipeline. Paul is the capture point: he shoots/photographs the raw material, drops it into ~/reed-dump/inbox/, inbox-watcher.js organizes it, and it becomes motion-reference / raw material for Reed. reconcileInbox() in capture-wishlist.js auto-marks items captured when a matching file lands in the inbox. Edit via CLI (capture-wishlist.js add/done) — code obeys this file.

conventions.filenameHint: Drop files into ~/reed-dump/inbox/ named like the item's suggestedName (e.g. logan-ref-jab.mov). inbox-watcher.js derives subject tags from the hyphen-split filename, and reconcileInbox() matches a wishlist item when the dropped filename contains the item's suggestedName stem OR all of its matchKeywords.

requests.what: Boxing motion-reference: a single clean JAB. 4 seconds, one fighter only, side-on or 3/4 angle, full body in frame, plain/uncluttered background, even light.
requests.for: Logan animated asset — Kling motion-control source. Drives the jab onto the Logan character.
requests.corpusNote: BR/Cuba corpus may already have a clean jab — check ~/boxing-corpus/technique/ and shadowboxing/ before reshooting. Existing clip can substitute.

requests.what: Boxing motion-reference: a single clean CROSS (straight rear hand). 4 seconds, one fighter, side-on/3-4, full body, clean background.
requests.for: Logan animated asset — Kling motion-control source for the cross.
requests.corpusNote: Check ~/boxing-corpus/ for an existing isolated cross before shooting.

requests.what: Boxing motion-reference: a single clean HOOK (lead hand). 4 seconds, one fighter, clean background, full body.
requests.for: Logan animated asset — Kling motion-control source for the hook.
requests.corpusNote: Corpus substitute possible — check technique/ folder.

requests.what: Boxing motion-reference: a single clean SLIP (defensive head movement off-line). 4 seconds, one fighter, side-on, full body.
requests.for: Logan animated asset — Kling motion-control source for the slip / defensive motion.
requests.corpusNote: Corpus substitute possible — defensive movement clips in movement/ or technique/.

requests.what: Boxing motion-reference: GUARD-RECOVERY — hands snapping back to high guard after a punch. 4 seconds, one fighter, clean background.
requests.for: Logan animated asset — Kling motion-control source for the reset-to-guard beat that ends most combinations.
requests.corpusNote: Likely embedded in existing padwork — may need a deliberate clean take.

requests.what: Boxing motion-reference: a short COMBINATION (e.g. jab-cross-hook, ending in guard recovery). 4 seconds, one fighter, clean background, full body in frame the whole time.
requests.for: Logan animated asset — Kling motion-control source for a full combination beat (the signature 'action' shot).
requests.corpusNote: Shadowboxing clip 'punches shadow technique.mov' in corpus may already serve — review first.

requests.what: Clean IDLE / breathing reference: fighter in stance, high guard, subtle weight-shift and breathing, NO punches. 4-6 seconds, one fighter, locked-off framing, clean background.
requests.for: Logan signature loop — the idle/breathing animation that plays when Logan is at rest (the seamless loop base).
requests.corpusNote: Unlikely in corpus (everyone is working) — probably a fresh deliberate take. Keep it very still.

requests.what: HK-location WALK: subject walking toward/across camera in a recognisable Hong Kong street/setting. 4-6 seconds, steady, full body.
requests.for: Logan universe — HK-location establishing motion for environment composites.
requests.corpusNote: No corpus equivalent — street capture, shoot when out.

requests.what: PRESENCE clip: subject standing still, looking to camera / off-camera, minimal motion, strong eye line. 4 seconds, chest-up or full body, controlled light.
requests.for: Logan universe — 'presence' beat for character reveals and title moments.
requests.corpusNote: No corpus equivalent — deliberate portrait-style capture.

requests.what: Hand-wrap CLOSEUP: tight on the wrap going around the knuckles/wrist, fabric texture visible, gym softly out of focus behind. Stills, a few angles.
requests.for: Maya BR content — fresh hand-wrap still for the 'ritual before the fight' content pillar.
requests.corpusNote: Content still, not motion — shoot fresh.

requests.what: Heavy-bag in LOW WARM LIGHT: the bag hanging (or mid-swing) lit with one warm low source, deep shadows, BR-grade mood. Stills.
requests.for: Maya BR content — atmospheric heavy-bag still for feed/hero use.
requests.corpusNote: Content still — shoot fresh, warm low light.
